title: Primary Care Visit Logs Read for Telehealth Sick Visits
content:
**Medicaid Managed Care Membership — interpretive note of the primary care assignment unit**

When primary care office visits are re-rated as preventive or coordinated care, telehealth sick visits are counted from the primary care visit logs. Whose visit logs are read for telehealth sick visits follows the member's assignment history in the Primary Care Provider Assignment records, within the 12-month office re-rating window counted back from the review date (a visit date counts when it lies fewer than 12 whole months before the review date).

## Rule

- **A previous assignment ended because a newer one superseded it** (an ended assignment whose end reason records supersession): the logs of both the current and the superseded assignment are read over the whole 12-month window.
- **A previous assignment ended for any other reason** (an ended assignment exists, none of them ended as superseded): only the current assignment's log is read, dated within one more than the whole months elapsed since the current assignment's effective date.
- **Otherwise** (no ended assignment on record): only the current assignment's log is read over the whole 12-month window.

"Dated within one more than the whole months elapsed since the effective date": count the whole months from the current assignment's effective date to the review date, add one, and read the visits dated fewer than that many whole months before the review date.

A telehealth sick visit is a visit a log that is read records with visit type sick visit and visit mode telehealth. Each such visit counted is one telehealth sick visit for re-rating.

## History grid

| Ended assignment on record | End reason of an ended assignment | Logs read | Dates read |
|---|---|---|---|
| Yes | Superseded | Current and superseded assignments | Whole 12-month window |
| Yes | Any other reason only | Current assignment only | Within one more than the whole months since the current effective date |
| No | — | Current assignment only | Whole 12-month window |

## Hypothetical cases

Inputs chosen for illustration only.

- **Case 1.** An earlier assignment ended as superseded; its log shows 2 telehealth sick visits in the window and the current log shows 1. Counted: 3.
- **Case 2.** An earlier assignment ended for a reason other than supersession; the current assignment took effect 3 whole months before the review date. Only the current log is read, dated fewer than 4 whole months before the review date; the earlier log's telehealth sick visits are not counted.
- **Case 3.** The member has only ever held the current assignment. Its log is read over the whole 12-month window.
